# Mr Aqar (مستر عقار)

> Kuwait real estate platform for buying, selling, and renting properties.

## Site

- [Home](https://mr-aqar.com/): Browse latest property listings
- [Search](https://mr-aqar.com/search): Search properties by area, type, and price
- [Offices](https://mr-aqar.com/offices): Real estate offices directory
- [Plans](https://mr-aqar.com/plans): Subscription plans for advertisers
- [About](https://mr-aqar.com/about): About Mr Aqar
- [Contact](https://mr-aqar.com/contact): Contact support
- [Terms](https://mr-aqar.com/terms): Terms and conditions
- [Privacy](https://mr-aqar.com/privacy): Privacy policy
